instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Design a priority encoder that identifies the position of the first low bit in an 8-bit binary input. The Verilog module should accept two inputs, each of 8-bit binary numbers. The output port should provide a 3-bit binary number that represents the position of the first low bit in the input vector. The module must be implemented using a combinational logic circuit. Additionally, create an addictive functional module that takes in the outputs of the priority encoder and the adder module in problem 1. The final output should be the difference between the positions of the first low bits in the two inputs.
